places.name: Te Papa Tongarewa
places.ai_summary: New Zealand's national museum, offering interactive exhibits on the country's history, culture, and natural environment.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Gallipoli exhibition for a moving experience.

attribution.title: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa unsaturated
attribution.author: Ulrich Lange, Bochum, Germany
attribution.description: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa, Wellington, New Zealand (2009) (front side with entrance)

places.name: Wellington Cable Car
places.ai_summary: A historic cable car ride offering panoramic views of Wellington and access to the Botanic Garden.
places.place_tip: Visit the Cable Car Museum at the top station.

places.name: Zealandia
places.ai_summary: An eco-sanctuary dedicated to preserving New Zealand's native wildlife, featuring walking trails and guided tours.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the sanctuary’s conservation efforts.

places.name: Wellington Botanic Garden
places.ai_summary: A stunning garden showcasing New Zealand's native and exotic plants, with walking tracks and a café.
places.place_tip: Check out the Lady Norwood Rose Garden.

attribution.title: Wellington Botanical Garden 10
attribution.author: Krzysztof Golik
attribution.description: Wellington Botanical Garden in Wellington, New Zealand

places.name: Mount Victoria Lookout
places.ai_summary: A popular lookout point offering panoramic views of Wellington, the harbor, and the surrounding hills.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

attribution.author: eythian
attribution.description:

places.name: Cuba Street
places.ai_summary: A vibrant and eclectic street known for its bohemian atmosphere, shops, cafés, and street art.

opening_hours.notes: Many shops and cafés have extended hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique finds.

attribution.title: Upper Central Cuba Street at night
attribution.author: Aubernas
attribution.description: Vintage kiwi buildings adorn upper central Cuba street in the soft winter evening light, Wellington- 25 July 2020. If you wish to use please let me know and give me full credit.

places.name: Parliament Buildings (The Beehive)
places.ai_summary: The iconic building of New Zealand's Parliament, known for its unique beehive shape and political significance.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about New Zealand's political system.

places.name: City Gallery Wellington
places.ai_summary: An art gallery showcasing contemporary New Zealand art, with rotating exhibitions and a café.
places.place_tip: Check out the bookshop for unique art books.

attribution.title: Trapezegallery
attribution.author: K Hanger (KHanger at en.wikipedia)
attribution.description: City Gallery, Civic Square, Wellington, New Zealand

places.name: Wellington Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Wellington's social and maritime history, with interactive exhibits and a café.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the interactive exhibits for kids.

places.name: Oriental Bay
places.ai_summary: A popular beach and recreational area close to the city center, with a sandy beach, promenade, and park.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a walk or cycle along the waterfront.

places.name: Space Place at Carter Observatory
places.ai_summary: An observatory and planetarium offering interactive exhibits and shows about space and astronomy.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for planetarium showtimes.
places.address: 40 Salamanca Rd, Kelburn, Wellington, New Zealand

places.name: Katherine Mansfield House & Garden
places.ai_summary: The former home of writer Katherine Mansfield, now a museum dedicated to her life and work.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful gardens and enjoy a guided tour of the house.

places.name: Wellington Waterfront
places.ai_summary: A scenic waterfront area with walking and cycling paths, parks, and views of the harbor and city.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the waterfront cafés.

places.name: Old St Paul's Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A historic wooden cathedral known for its stunning architecture and beautiful stained glass windows.
places.place_tip: Attend a concert or service for a unique experience.

places.name: City to Sea Bridge
places.ai_summary: A pedestrian and cycle bridge offering great views of the city, harbor, and beyond.
places.place_tip: Great spot for photos, especially at sunset.

places.name: Remutaka Cycle Trail
places.ai_summary: A scenic cycling trail through the Remutaka Range, offering stunning views and a glimpse of the region's history.
places.place_tip: Start early to enjoy the trail before it gets too hot.
places.address: Remutaka Hill Rd, Wellington, New Zealand

places.name: Matiu/Somes Island
places.ai_summary: A wildlife sanctuary and historic site, accessible by ferry, with walking tracks and guided tours.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry operates daily, but times may vary.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking the tracks.

places.name: Wellington Zoo
places.ai_summary: New Zealand's oldest zoo, home to a wide variety of native and exotic animals, with a focus on conservation.
places.place_tip: Check out the daily animal feeding times.

places.name: Interislander Ferry Terminal
places.ai_summary: The terminal for the Interislander ferry, connecting Wellington to Picton, with stunning views of the Marlborough Sounds.

opening_hours.notes: Check ferry schedule for departure times.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to enjoy the views from the deck.
